subject: Appointments, Chief Judge and Presiding Judges
description: Preliminary Order Appointments, Chief Judge and Presiding Judges [Lincoln County, Thomas O. Branford]
title: Oregon Supreme Court Order 2012-056 — Preliminary Order Appointments, Chief Judge and Presiding Judges [Lincoln County, Thomas O. Branford]
text:
IN THE SUPREME COURT OF THE STATE OF OREGON
In the Matter of the Appointment )
of the Presiding Judge in the 17th )
Judicial District, Lincoln County )
NO. 12-056
PRELIMINARY ORDER
APPOINTING PRESIDING JUDGE
After conferring with and seeking the advice of the justices of the Supreme
Court and seeking the advice of the judges of Lincoln County concerned in respect of the
appointment of:
PRESIDING JUDGE
The following individual is preliminarily appointed presiding judge for the
17th Judicial District, Lincoln County, indicated below for the period January 1, 2013, to
December 31, 2013:
THOMAS 0. BRANFORD
A copy of this order shall be given to every judge of Lincoln County.
